definition: Calming or tranquility, especially as a mode of meditation development paired with insight.

example_phrases.notes: One of the five supports of right view in MN 43, a translated surface. The record previously cited SN 35.204, an Ajjhattātītayadanicca repetition sutta in the Saṭṭhipeyyāla vagga, which contains neither `samatha` nor `vipassanā`. Repaired in the 2026-09-13 Wave 11 audit.
